title: John Aristotle Phillips' atomic bomb junior thesis at Princeton
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of John Aristotle Phillips' atomic bomb junior thesis at Princeton, about 1976-1977 at Princeton University, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You had a guy named John Aristotle Phillips who was a junior at Princeton who chose Freeman Dyson for his advisor for his junior thesis.

plain: A thinker named Eric Weinstein, speaking on a podcast, tells of John Aristotle Phillips, a third-year student at Princeton University in the mid-1970s. Weinstein says Phillips picked the physicist Freeman Dyson to advise his junior thesis, a paper about the atomic bomb, and he brings it up in a talk about how secret knowledge can be worked out by outsiders.
